articles.summary: Alliant Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: LNT) has scheduled its third quarter earnings release for Thursday, October 29 th , after market close. A conference call to review the third quarter results is scheduled for Friday, October 30 th at 9 a.m. CT. Alliant Energy will webcast the event live at www.alliantenergy.com/investors . The call is open to the public and will be hosted by Lisa Barton, President and CEO; and Robert Durian, Executive Vice President and CFO. Individuals who would like to participate in the conference call can do so by dialing (833) 461-5787 (Toll Free – North America) or (585) 542-9983 (US Local). The conference ID is 650 333 381. The public conference dial-in pre-registration link is: https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/650333381?pwd=6nHcwwnr An archive of the webcast will be available on the company’s website at www.alliantenergy.com/investors . articles.summary: The Alliant Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: LNT) Board of Directors today declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.5350 per share payable on November 16, 2026, to shareowners of record as of the close of business on October 30, 2026. Dividends on common stock have been paid for 324 consecutive quarters since 1946. Alliant Energy Corporation is recognized as a member of the SP 500 Dividend Aristocrats Index. Alliant Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: LNT) provides regulated energy service to approximately 1,010,000 electric and 435,000 natural gas customers across Iowa and Wisconsin. Alliant Energy's mission is to deliver energy solutions and exceptional service customers and communities count on – safely, efficiently and responsibly. Interstate Power and Light Company (IPL) and Wisconsin Power and Light Company (WPL) are Alliant Energy's two public energy companies. Alliant Energy is a component of the SP 500. articles.summary: Today, Alliant Energy (NASDAQ: LNT) closed on a $5.1 billion lower-interest loan package from the U.S. Department of Energy’s (DOE) Office of Energy Dominance Financing (EDF). Over the life of the 30-year loans, Alliant Energy projects up to $1.2 billion in cumulative customer savings. In addition to lowering costs for customers, the company projects more than 1,600 local jobs will be created during construction of the projects supported by the loans. “As energy needs continue to grow across the communities we serve, we are making smart, forward-looking investments to deliver safe, reliable and cost-effective energy for our customers,” said Lisa Barton, president and CEO of Alliant Energy. “This federally backed financing helps lower the cost of building the generation and critical energy infrastructure our customers depend on, while strengthening the grid and supporting long-term savings.
